item.title: Attachable 1.0.5
item.description:
### Attachable 1.0.5
- Compress several files at once without zipping them: each gets its own smaller copy, and together they fit one email. Right-click → Attachable: Compress, or the arrow next to Compress to ZIP. - Clearer right-click menu: "Attachable: Compress", "Attachable: Compress to ZIP" and "Attachable: Combine to PDF", all with the paperclip. - Dropping more files onto the list now works anywhere in the box. - A ZIP or PDF made from files in different folders now saves where most of them came from, and says where. A dropped folder's ZIP saves next to the folder. - Dragging to reorder the list looks cleaner. - Small fixes.
